blogs.title: Computer Vision in Infrastructure Monitoring: AI-Powered Road & Asset Inspection
blogs.description: How modern deep learning object detection (YOLO, Faster R-CNN) and PCI assessment algorithms are revolutionizing road condition inspection and maintenance.
blogs.excerpt: Exploring how deep learning models detect road pavement defects, calculate Pavement Condition Index (PCI), and automate municipal infrastructure surveys.
blogs.author: Zahid Marwat

blogs.title: Building Desktop Annotation & Quality Control Tools with Electron, React, and Flask
blogs.description: Architecture and design patterns for building desktop annotation software that handles JSON, XML, and LabelMe formats with real-time bounding box and polygon rendering.
blogs.excerpt: A deep dive into integrating Electron IPC, React interactive canvas components, and a Flask backend for high-speed dataset quality review.
blogs.author: Zahid Marwat
